slides.headline: The Problem Isn't Networking
slides.sidebar_body: Networking itself isn't the problem. Building professional relationships, sharing knowledge, collaborating, and referring customers are legitimate activities. The difference is what the network exists to produce. In BOSS, a practitioner network coordinates expertise and projects, not recruitment commissions.
